Change c0479. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. VII; 1831 Ch. XXIV.

Context before (unchanged): Let the cursed and hellish monster drink deep of agony; let him feel the despair that now torments me."

1818 text: I had begun my adjuration with solemnity, and an awe which almost assured me that the shades of my murdered friends heard and approved my devotion; but the furies possessed me as I concluded, and rage choaked my utterance.

1831 text: I had begun my adjuration with solemnity, and an awe which almost assured me that the shades of my murdered friends heard and approved my devotion; but the furies possessed me as I concluded, and rage choked my utterance.

Diff: I had begun my adjuration with solemnity, and an awe which almost assured me that the shades of my murdered friends heard and approved my devotion; but the furies possessed me as I concluded, and rage [-choaked-] {+choked+} my utterance.

Context after (unchanged): I was answered through the stillness of night by a loud and fiendish laugh.

result.rationale: Change is orthographic only: 'choaked' becomes 'choked' with no change in wording or meaning. Same verb, corrected spelling.
